description: This file defines the class MaxCountExceededException, an exception class used in the Apache Commons Math library to signal that a maximum count or evaluation limit has been exceeded during computation. It extends MathIllegalStateException and includes constructors to specify the maximum count and optional context.

classes.name: MaxCountExceededException
classes.description: An exception indicating that a maximum count or evaluation limit has been exceeded during mathematical computations.

methods.name: MaxCountExceededException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a maximum count value, using a default localized message.

methods.name: MaxCountExceededException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a specific localizable message, maximum count, and additional arguments.

methods.name: getMax
methods.description: Returns the maximum count that was exceeded.
